prediction_text: Direction: Barack Obama is re-elected — he wins the 2012 US presidential election against Mitt Romney. The Mercury retrograde beginning on election day (6 November 2012) marks counting/communication confusion, delays and disputes around the vote, but it does not reverse the result: retrograde favours return to the previous state, i.e. the incumbent returns to office. Confidence: moderate.
basis: 卡面未标注 tradition/system 字段; system actually used: western (mundane/electional) astrology. Anchor on the card: Mercury turns retrograde on election day itself. In electional/mundane convention, a retrograde Mercury on the decisive day signifies recounts, muddled counts and contested communications, and symbolically a going-back — the electorate returns the sitting president rather than installing a new one. Incumbency is the status quo the retrograde points back to. No natal charts are supplied on the card and none are invented; the prediction rests on the stated election-day configuration plus the incumbent/challenger structure given in the setting.
